name: megascenes-sound-effects
description: Create sound effects from a description, from footsteps and doors to sci-fi whooshes and ambiences, for videos and games.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a sound and get it as an audio file: footsteps on gravel, a creaking door, a laser blast, rain on a tin roof or a busy café ambience.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the sound in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The sound plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For video editors, game developers and podcasters.

Limitations: new sounds from a description; it does not clean up or edit audio you attach in the chat. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create sound effects from a description
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: Footsteps on wet gravel, slow, 4 seconds
A sci-fi door opening with a hiss
Busy café ambience with cups and chatter

positive.prompt: Footsteps on wet gravel, slow, 4 seconds. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one sound effect needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A sci-fi door opening with a hiss. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one sound effect needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which sound effect models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The sound models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Busy café ambience with cups and soft chatter, 10 seconds. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my sound effect and ship them to my store.
Send my sound effect to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
